The '''Red Bull BC One''' is an annual international [[breakdancing]] (B-Boy) competition, established in 2004. The competition is organised by the beverage company Red Bull. Its first event was held in Biel, Switzerland in 2004.

The competition's main event is a knockout tournament, featuring sixteen break dancers. The format involves one-on-one battles judged by a panel of five experienced judges

Red Bull BC One's has regional finals held in various parts of the world, including [[North America]], [[Eastern Europe]], [[Western Europe]], [[Latin America]], [[Asia–Pacific|Asia Pacific]], the [[Middle East]] and [[Africa]]. These regional winners compete in the World Finals, representing their regions internationally.

In the 2004 and 2005 events Red Bull BC released an official video that has been criticized due to restrictive music playing rights, as the live music played during the competition had to be dubbed over.<ref>{{Citation |last= |title=Red Bull BC One: Berlin 2005 Breakdancing Championship |date=2006-09-12 |url=https://www.amazon.com/Red-Bull-One-Breakdancing-Championship/dp/B000GW8S06 |access-date=2023-06-30 |publisher=Rhino}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2007-09-29|title=Bboyworld.com - Your Number 1 B-Boy & B-Girl Source |url=http://www.bboyworld.com/forum/video-song-lists/42541-red-bull-bc-one-2005-a.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20070928002522/http://www.bboyworld.com/forum/video-song-lists/42541-red-bull-bc-one-2005-a.html |archive-date=2007-09-28 |access-date=2023-06-30}}</ref> From 2006 onwards, Red Bull stopped releasing DVDs and made the videos available online for free.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2009-09-16 |title=Red Bull BC One - Official Blog : We read your comments / 27 October 2007 |url=http://redbullbcone.com/blog/we-read-your-comments |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090916234815/http://redbullbcone.com/blog/we-read-your-comments |archive-date=2009-09-16 |access-date=2023-06-30}}</ref> In 2007, Alastair Siddons directed a film about the Red Bull BC One 2007 competition. The film was released in 2009 under the title, '''Turn it Loose'.''<ref>{{Cite web |title=Turn It Loose (2009) |url=https://www.avclub.com/film/reviews/turn-it-loose-2009 |access-date=2024-06-22 |website=The A.V. Club |language=en}}</ref>

Since 2014, Red Bull BC One has partnered with the [[World BBoy Series|World B-Boy Series]] to help create [[World BBoy Series|Undisputed]], which crowns a solo world B-Boy champion.<ref>{{cite web |title=Freestyle Session | Events |url=http://freestylesession.com/blog/?page_id=65 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131109203802/http://freestylesession.com/blog/?page_id=65 |archive-date=2013-11-09 |access-date=2013-11-09}}</ref>

=== 2014 ===
In 2014 Red Bull BC One took place in [[Paris|Paris, France]] with a round-by-round judging system used by [[International B-Boy Championships#Undisputed|Undisputed]]. The round-by-round judging format allows boys to see the judges decision after every round. The battle is set for 3 rounds (Finals is 5) but can end if a boy beats his opponent in 2.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Spot |first=The Bboy |date=2023-06-30 |title=The Bboy Spot |url=http://www.thebboyspot.com/judging-format-at-undisputed-world-bboy-series-events/ |access-date=2023-06-30 |website=The Bboy Spot - Strictly Bboyin' and ALWAYS Hiphop! |language=en-US}}</ref>

However, this judging system received a lot of criticism from Red Bull BC One fans throughout social media following the event. Bboys and fans alike, both disagreed with the judges's decisions after many individual battles.

Many argued that it was the worst Red Bull BC one competition since its initiation. Due to '''Menno's''' ({{#invoke:flag|icon|NED}}) victory and Chelles Battle Pro, '''Gravity''' ({{#invoke:flag|icon|USA}}) was awarded the final spot at [[International B-Boy Championships#Undisputed|Undisputed]] at the end of the year following Red Bull BC One.

== Red Bull BC One All Stars ==

Red Bull BC One All Stars is a crew of internationally renowned dancers. Together, they showcase the art of B-Boying in all of its many forms. Each of the B-Boys/B-Girls has competed in the Red Bull BC One.

They travel the world to teach workshops, judge competitions and battle.
